result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street with row houses and mature street trees providing a buffer. While sidewalks are present and in good condition, the environment lacks marked pedestrian crossings and visibility is partially obstructed by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block the line of sight between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the roadway, increasing risk for mid-block crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground and midground.

result.summary: This narrow, one-way residential street features continuous sidewalks and small street trees, which helps with traffic calming. However, the high density of parked cars on both sides creates visual obstructions, and there are no visible marked crosswalks or curb ramps to facilitate safe crossing.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on both sides of the narrow street block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway along the curb

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross mid-block or at uncontrolled intersections without guidance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at corners to shorten crossing distances and prevent illegal parking that blocks sightlines.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way at intersections.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street intersection with sidewalks but no marked pedestrian crossings or curb ramps. While the narrow roadway width likely encourages low vehicle speeds, the lack of formal crossing infrastructure and traffic control creates ambiguity for right-of-way and accessibility barriers.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross, which may lead to unpredictable movements and reduced driver awareness.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection in the foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped transitions at the corners creates a physical barrier for people with disabilities, strollers, or carts.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled intersection
hazards.description: The absence of stop or yield signs at the junction creates ambiguity regarding right-of-way between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver yielding.

interventions.title: Construct ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all corners to ensure the pedestrian network is accessible.

interventions.title: Intersection Traffic Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs to regulate vehicle flow and clarify right-of-way at the junction.
